source_refs.note: Topic 7.6 as printed, with Figs. 7.8 and 7.9, Examples 7.4 and 7.5 and the A Scientific Fact, Ponder Upon and Brain Teaser boxes (PDF 150-155, printed 147-152). The print calls f3 = 3f1 of a closed pipe the 'second harmonic'; marked.

blocks.text: Stationary waves can be set up in other media also, such as air column inside a pipe or tube. A common example of vibrating air column is in the organ pipe.
